title: Who supplies the missing step?
hook: A toy team can fetch parts and check assemblies, but an intermediate skill may be absent.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to distinguish access to a whole process from personally supplying its missing operation

misconception: Recognizing the inputs and outputs of a system establishes the ability to supply every intermediate step.
objective: Distinguish access to a whole process from personally supplying its missing operation.
